purpose: Evaluate deployed failure capture and unchanged reasoning-on 35B compatibility diagnostic
required_evidence: actual candidate residency and full layer offload
durable bounded model-result packet before failed trial state when requests fail
request finish reasons and measured elapsed times
all five restored checkpoints and scheduled work

interpretation.returned_unscored: A complete response was returned; grounded correctness remains unscored except the fixed arithmetic predicate.
interpretation.token_limit: No complete usable answer; elapsed time is not accepted usable-answer latency.
interpretation.timeout_or_transport_failure: Incomplete response; retain the actual attempt and failure without inferring a latency win.
interpretation.failed_restored: Negative trial result with restoration; inspect the retained packet and exact failure rather than treating safe restoration as model success.
interpretation.new_device_or_oom_hazard: Stop experimentation and preserve incident evidence; no blind GPU retry.

milestone_limit: Two compatibility requests cannot establish improved grounded capability or fresh accepted 9B p50/p95 parity; no tuning or promotion is authorized by a complete packet alone.
